children: Morgan Stanley (MS) Q3 2026: revenues $20.34B, EPS $3.03, net income $4.9B. Equity trading +41% to $5.8B; FICC -7% to $2.01B. NII $3.25B. $1.5B buybacks; $1.15 dividend.
Morgan Stanley (MS) reported $10.5 trillion in total client assets at quarter end, with $8.4 trillion tied to its wealth platform and about 21 million client relationships.
Morgan Stanley (MS) saw record asset-management net inflows of $232 billion this quarter, driven largely by IPO-related funds; investors kept allocating to external assets despite market volatility.
Morgan Stanley (MS) posted $141M in credit provisions, including $105M in charge-offs from corporate and commercial real estate loans, citing growth in corporate and secured-lending portfolios.
Morgan Stanley (MS) says AI investments drive growth, using AI tools to boost client services and internal operations and assigning higher exposure to AI opportunities.
Morgan Stanley CFO Sharon Yeshaya says the firm is selective on AI financing risks and warns peers may be loosening credit standards, stressing careful risk management in AI loans.
Morgan Stanley (MS) served as lead underwriter on SpaceX’s IPO and earned about $100 million in investment-banking fees from the deal.
Morgan Stanley (MS) earnings outlook slipped: mean estimate down ~5.7% in three months; 16 analysts cut estimates in the past 30 days.
Morgan Stanley (MS) reported $2.16B investment banking revenue, up 2%, led advisory on Uber’s Delivery Hero deal and joined IPO syndicates for AI firms Anthropic and OpenAI.
